_comment: Web of Science subject categories per venue, read from Journal Citation
Reports (2025 JCR year) via Yonsei's subscription. Clarivate's own
Multi-label by nature: JASIST carries two categories, DIGITAL HEALTH four.
Any facet built on this has to let a paper appear under each of them.
INCOMPLETE — collected one journal at a time through the JCR interface,
which has no bulk export without a personal Clarivate account. Venues not
yet looked up are absent rather than guessed. The eleven conference papers
(SIGKDD, IJCAI, ICMR, RACS, BigComp, ICHI, ER, JIST, ISSI) have no WoS
journal category at all — they are indexed in CPCI — and Information
issn is the ISSN JCR lists, which is sometimes the print ISSN where our
publication data holds the electronic one (JMIR: 1439-4456 here vs
1438-8871 in ours), so match on venue name, not on ISSN alone.
